WITH weekly AS (
    SELECT
        logistics_provider,
        week_block,
        SUM(sum_bwt) / SUM(parcel_qty) AS avg_BWT
    FROM spx
    GROUP BY logistics_provider, week_block
),
diff AS (
    SELECT
        w1.logistics_provider,
        w1.avg_BWT AS first_week,
        w2.avg_BWT AS last_week,
        w2.avg_BWT - w1.avg_BWT AS diff
    FROM weekly w1
    JOIN weekly w2
      ON w1.logistics_provider = w2.logistics_provider
     AND w1.week_block = 'W1'
     AND w2.week_block = 'W5'
)
SELECT
    logistics_provider,
    first_week,
    last_week,
    diff
FROM diff
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10;
